notes:
Summary:
- Enterprise support SaaS (ticketing + live chat) evaluating RAG to increase self-serve and deflection rate. Primary goal: reduce agent handled tickets by 30% while preserving answer accuracy.
- Emphasis on embeddings + reranking pipeline: large index (~3M docs initially, planned growth to 8-10M), sub-120ms p95 latency target for first-pass search + rerank for top-5 results.
Technical requirements / constraints:
- Index scale: ~3M heterogeneous docs (kb articles, forum posts, transcripts). Expect 40-60k daily updates/ingests. Need efficient incremental indexing.
- Embeddings: prefer open/quantized embeddings but flexible; want model recommendations from Redwood Optimize that balance cost/quality. Target cost per customer query <= $0.003 (embeddings+ranks).
- Reranking: candidate recall from vector search must be high; reranker only reorders top-100 -> deliver top-5 final with MRR/top5 quality target >0.90.
- Latency: 95th percentile strict: <= 120ms end-to-end for query (vector search + lightweight reranker). If using heavier reranker, need fallbacks.
- Throughput: peak 500 qps for search during EMEA morning. Autoscaling must be predictable.
- Deployment: VPC + private networking for customer data with optional Dedicated environment. SOC2 and audit logging required. KMS + SSO/SAML.
POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: ingest 3M-doc snapshot (they will provide export), replay 48h of production traffic (anonymized).
- Week 1: baseline using Redwood-hosted embeddings + dense vector index, measure recall/latency/cost.
- Week 2: enable reranker (small family model), tune cutoffs, measure top-5 quality and p95 latency.
- Deliverable: perf deck + cost model + recommended config for Dedicated or Hosted.
